review_improvement: Exposes the impossible RAID0 rebuild requirement and replaces unsafe guessed storage commands with an exact, phase-gated disposable-device contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: RAID0 stripes data without redundancy, so failing or removing one member destroys availability and there is no mirror/parity rebuild back to active sync. Applying the generic RAID1/5 section would not test RAID0 resilience; it would intentionally break the array. The level must therefore be resolved before any irreversible mdadm or mkfs action.
